problem_statement: Build a brand-new Cohort Retention view at the route /cohorts on the technext V-Dashboard template (Vue 3 + Vite + vue-router with createWebHistory, Tailwind CSS 2). The route does not exist yet (baseline renders an empty page). Construct the full page from scratch reusing the site's existing design system: it must render inside the DashboardLayout so the shared sidebar/header chrome is inherited, and reuse the bg-white rounded-md shadow-sm card style, text-gray-700 headings and indigo-600 accents used across Dashboard/Tables/Cards. The page must include: (1) a 'Cohort Retention' page heading (h3) with a one-line intro paragraph starting 'Track how each'; (2) a date-bucket selector with three range buttons - Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly (each carrying a data-bucket attribute) - with Monthly active on first paint; (3) a report card whose heading reflects the selected window (defaulting to 'Monthly cohorts') containing a cohort-retention TABLE (columns: Cohort, New users, Day 1, Day 7, Day 30) plus a 'Sort by Day-30 retention' button (data-sort). Selecting a date-bucket must re-compute the visible table and update the card heading. STATE-LINKED (T4): the selected date-bucket must PERSIST across the column sort - selecting Weekly then clicking Sort by Day-30 retention must keep the Weekly window (heading stays 'Weekly cohorts', weekly rows re-ordered), it must NOT reset to Monthly. The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on mobile (the wide table scrolls inside an overflow-x-auto container). REGRESSION: adding /cohorts must not disturb the shared dashboard chrome - the sidebar nav (Dashboard, Tables, ... links) must remain consistent on BOTH /cohorts and the sibling /dashboard route. Register /cohorts in src/router.ts so it renders inside the DashboardLayout (default layout).
required_content: 'Cohort Retention' page heading (h3) plus a one-line intro paragraph starting 'Track how each'
A date-bucket selector with three buttons - Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly - each carrying a data-bucket attribute, Monthly active by default
A report card whose heading reflects the active window (defaults to 'Monthly cohorts')
A cohort-retention table with columns Cohort / New users / Day 1 / Day 7 / Day 30, one row per cohort of the selected window
A 'Sort by Day-30 retention' button (data-sort) that re-orders the table rows by Day-30 retention
State-linked behaviour: selecting a bucket (e.g. Weekly) then sorting keeps that bucket's data visible (heading 'Weekly cohorts'); the sort must NOT reset the selection back to Monthly
Shared dashboard chrome (sidebar nav with Dashboard/Tables/... links) inherited on /cohorts and unchanged on the sibling /dashboard
Responsive layout that stacks on mobile with the wide table scrolling inside its container (no horizontal overflow)
design_constraints: Render inside the existing DashboardLayout (default layout) so the sidebar and header chrome are inherited
Reuse the site's Tailwind design tokens: bg-white rounded-md shadow-sm cards, text-gray-700 headings, text-gray-500/600 body, indigo-600 accents
The active bucket and sort order must be driven by reactive refs with @click handlers; the visible table is a computed derivation of (activeBucket, sortKey) so the bucket persists across the sort
The bucket buttons carry data-bucket attributes and the sort button a data-sort attribute for reliable selection

Match the reference palette (verified via palette-overlap): indigo-600 accent #4F46E5 (rgb 79,70,229) for active bucket button / links, white #FFFFFF card backgrounds, gray-200 #E5E7EB borders and table dividers, gray-500 #6B7280 body text and gray-700 #374151 headings.
The active date-bucket button must be visually distinguished with the indigo-600 accent (solid indigo fill or indigo text/border) while inactive buttons stay neutral gray.

The report card is a bg-white rounded-md shadow-sm panel containing the window heading followed by the cohort-retention table; the table header row uses gray-500 uppercase labels with gray-200 row dividers.
author_notes: Scheme A (Vue analog of gotcha #12, proven on slot_535 same repo family): baseline registers /cohorts as a TOP-LEVEL empty route with meta.layout='empty' + CohortsEmpty.vue (bare empty <div>, renders via EmptyLayout with no chrome) so check A sees text_length=0. reference implements the full page: bucket selector + retention table + sort, with the visible table a computed(activeBucket, sortKey) so the selected bucket PERSISTS across the sort. bad is identical EXCEPT toggleSort() also resets activeBucket back to 'monthly' - so selecting Weekly then sorting snaps the heading back to 'Monthly cohorts', breaking the state-linked interaction_assertion (changed_from desktop_cohorts -> 'Weekly cohorts' cannot hold). Static dom_assertions and the shared-nav regression/consistency assertions (on BOTH desktop_cohorts and desktop_dashboard) still pass on bad, so bad fails ONLY the state-linked interaction gate (clean targeted discrimination). Router uses createWebHistory so state_plan paths are plain /cohorts. Toolchain: same as slot_535 - upstream vite2/vue-tsc0 crash on Node 22 and the upstream router.ts imports a missing NotFound.vue; the proven modernized toolchain + built node_modules from build_slot_535_reference (vite ^5.4, vue-tsc ^2.1, vue ^3.4, vue-router ^4.4, @vitejs/plugin-vue ^5.1, typescript ^5.5, Tailwind 2 kept) was copied into all three workspaces so vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build passes offline (exit 0). Three workspace source trees are md5-distinct.

_build_meta.install: (corepack enable && corepack yarn install --frozen-lockfile) || npm install
